steps: Use retained SHA256-identified archives; extract each runtimeSubtree into that relative subtree in a new output directory. Copy runtimeFile inputs to their original relative paths.

Process all patchesInApplicationOrder in metadata-array order. Preserve whole original patches in the source archive. For the runtime subset, project only complete diff --git sections whose old or new path is under a retainedSubtree; patches with no such sections are not applied to the subset.
Apply projected sections using GNU patch -f -E -p1 --no-backup-if-mismatch --fuzz=0. Fail rather than silently skip a rejected hunk. Original retained base sources and archives stay unchanged.
This recreates runtime sources and supporting inputs only. It neither rebuilds the original compiler nor configures, compiles, tests, or certifies any runtime binary.
reconstruction.applicationStatus: Source reconstruction completed successfully: 21 projected patches (15 touching runtime directories) applied in exact metadata order with GNU patch --fuzz=0. Some hunks used exact-context line offsets. No builds, tests, lint, formatting, compiler invocations or runtime gates were run.
reconstruction.gitilesPackaging: Immutable revisions identify source contents, but Gitiles can regenerate archive packaging. SHA256 pins the exact retained download bytes, not a promise that a later same-URL response is byte-identical. Per-file inventories record decoded source content independently.

limits: Full LLVM compiler sources/binaries, SDK tools, personal SDK paths and signing material are not bundled here. Compiler-associated host tools are outside this runtime-source augmentation.

Original upstream compiler build environment, bootstrap compiler, prebuilt NDK sysroot and build invocation are external prerequisites for reproducing original NDK binary bytes. No bit-reproducibility certification is made.
The full runtime source directories include their upstream tests/docs/notices; none were run.

systemLibraryBoundary.policy: These sources are an extra conservative disclosure, not a claim that GPL requires rebuilding or bundling the Android SDK/compiler.
systemLibraryBoundary.gplSystemLibraries: GPLv3 System Libraries includes compiler-associated libraries subject to the definition's conditions. This manifest does not give a definitive legal classification or promise immunity.
systemLibraryBoundary.devicePlatform: Android device-provided libc/libm/libdl and operating-system/JNI interfaces are not copied into the APK by this source augmentation.
systemLibraryBoundary.staticallyBundled: C++ standard library, ABI, unwinder and compiler-rt archive portions selected by the native link are conservatively covered by these preferred-source materials.
